note: Voice sets for the inner voice (Dave 2026-10-21): the voice is compiled from the character's gender and traits, with no pick screen. src/shared/inner_voice_profile.gd chooses the set id <family>_<temperament>_<n>; tools/gen_inner_voice.py renders every line in data/items/inner_voice.json once per set with the text to voice engine Kokoro (Apache 2.0) into assets/audio/inner_voice/<set id>/<line id>.ogg. Voices are Kokoro voice ids; speed below 1 is slower.
